industries.name: Aerospace & defense
industries.blurb: Long-cycle programs with specialty alloys, castings and engines. Escalation clauses usually index to PPI aircraft parts and metals.

industries.name: Automotive
industries.blurb: High-volume parts with steel, aluminum, rubber and chips, much of it sourced in Mexico and Japan.

industries.name: Machinery & metal fabrication
industries.blurb: Steel- and copper-heavy builds; European components priced in euros.

industries.name: Electronics & semiconductors
industries.blurb: Chips, copper and resin, with supply concentrated in Taiwan, Korea and China.

industries.name: Chemicals & plastics
industries.blurb: Feedstock-driven: crude oil and natural gas flow through petrochemicals into resins within months.

industries.name: Construction
industries.blurb: Bid-to-build lag makes escalation risk real; lumber and steel swing hardest.

industries.name: Electric utilities
industries.blurb: Fuel costs pass through to rates; grid equipment (transformers, cable) has long lead times.

industries.name: Food & beverage manufacturing
industries.blurb: Grains, sweeteners and oils drive ingredient cost; cans and glass drive packaging.

industries.name: Restaurants & food service
industries.blurb: Protein, eggs and labor are the big three; distributor delivery fees follow diesel.

industries.name: Retail & e-commerce fulfillment
industries.blurb: Parcel, warehousing and corrugated are the controllable cost lines.

industries.name: Packaging & CPG
industries.blurb: Substrates (paper, resin, metal, glass) set packaging cost; aluminum drives cans.

industries.name: Healthcare
industries.blurb: Drugs, devices and supplies under GPO contracts; many generics and supplies come from China.

industries.name: Trucking & freight
industries.blurb: Diesel feeds fuel surcharges within weeks; freight volumes flag capacity shifts.

industries.name: Airlines, air cargo & ocean
industries.blurb: Jet fuel and ocean rates dominate; China and euro lanes carry FX exposure.

industries.name: Agriculture
industries.blurb: Input buyers face fertilizer, chemicals, machinery and fuel; crop prices set what growers can absorb.

industries.name: Oil & gas
industries.blurb: Oilfield service and tubular pricing follows crude with a lag; rig activity drives the cycle.

industries.name: Data centers
industries.blurb: Power, servers, chips, transformers and cooling; electrical gear has the longest lead times.
